svg.desc: GIG Headquarters LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Gig COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2021 80 million EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Completed in 2021, the GIG headquarters in New Cairo spans six floors with two underground levels, each covering 4,500 m2. Designed to reflect a modern corporate identity, the 80 million EGP project included architecture, structural and MEP works, landscape, interior design, environmental services, and full project management and site supervision for Arab Misr Insurance Group (GIG).
